_description: Blocks rm -rf and warns on mv commands that appear to involve paths outside the current directory. PowerShell equivalents (Remove-Item, Move-Item) included. Known limitations with substring matching: (1) 'mv file ../backup' is NOT caught (mv .. only fires when .. is the source, e.g. 'mv ../file .'); (2) 'mv file /tmp' is NOT caught (mv / only fires when / is the source); (3) env-var-expanded paths like $HOME are not detected. These are documented as acceptable given the matcher's constraints.
